import datetime\n\nBase = declarative_base()\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Cat(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"cats\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    breed = Column(String)\n    age = Column(Integer)\n    description = Column(Text)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"available\", check_constraint=\"status IN ('available', 'pending', 'adopted', 'medical_hold', 'deceased')\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass AdoptionApplication(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"adoption_applications\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    application_number = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    cat_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"cats.id\", ondelete=\"RESTRICT\", onupdate=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    applicant_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\", ondelete=\"RESTRICT\", onupdate=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"submitted\", check_constraint=\"status IN ('submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'completed')\")\n    submitted_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    reviewed_at = Column(DateTime)\n    cancelled_at = Column(DateTime)\n    cancellation_reason = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Payment(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"payments\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    payment_number = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    application_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"adoption_applications.id\", ondelete=\"SET NULL\", onupdate=\"CASCADE\"))\n    payer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\", ondelete=\"RESTRICT\", onupdate=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    amount = Column(Integer, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"amount > 0\")\n    currency = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"USD\")\n    payment_type = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"payment_type IN ('adoption_fee', 'donation', 'deposit', 'refund')\")\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False,       "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import AdoptionApplication, Payment\nfrom schemas import CancelAdoptionApplicationRequest, CancelAdoptionApplicationResponse\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"AdoptionApplications\"])\n\n\n@router.patch(\n    \"/api/adoption-applications/{application_id}/cancel\",\n    operation_id=\"cancel_adoption_application\",\n    response_model=CancelAdoptionApplicationResponse,\n)\nasync def cancel_adoption_application(\n    application_id: str,\n    payload: CancelAdoptionApplicationRequest,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    # Find the adoption application by application_number\n    db_application = (\n        db.query(AdoptionApplication)\n        .filter(AdoptionApplication.application_number == application_id)\n        .first()\n    )\n\n    if not db_application:\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,\n            detail=\"Adoption application not found\",\n        )\n\n    # Check if the application can be cancelled\n    if db_application.status not in [\"submitted\", \"under_review\", \"approved\"]:\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,\n            detail=\"Application cannot be cancelled in its current status\",\n        )\n\n    # Update the adoption application\n    db_application.status = \"cancelled\"\n    db_application.cancelled_at = datetime.utcnow()\n    db_application.cancellation_reason = payload.cancellation_reason\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(db_application)\n\n    # Find the associated payment\n    db_payment = (\n        db.query(Payment)\n        .filter(Payment.application_id == db_application.id)\n        .first()\n    )\n\n    # If there is a payment and it's completed, void it\n    if db_payment and db_payment.status == \"completed\":\n        db_payment.status = \"voided\"\n        db_payment.voided_at = datetime.utcnow()\n        db_payment.void_reason = payload.cancellation_reason\n        db.commit()\n        db.refresh(db_payment)\n\n    return CancelAdoptionApplicationResponse(\n        application=db_application,\n        payment=db_payment,\n    )"
    },

      "path": "routers/group_002.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Payment\nfrom schemas import VoidPaymentRequest, VoidPaymentResponse\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"Payments\"])\n\n\n@router.post(\n    \"/api/payments/{payment_id}/void\",\n    operation_id=\"void_payment\",\n    response_model=VoidPaymentResponse,\n)\nasync def void_payment(\n    payment_id: str,\n    payload: VoidPaymentRequest,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    # Find the payment by payment_number\n    db_payment = (\n        db.query(Payment)\n        .filter(Payment.payment_number == payment_id)\n        .first()\n    )\n\n    if not db_payment:\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,\n            detail=\"Payment not found\",\n        )\n\n    # Check if the payment can be voided\n    if db_payment.status != \"completed\":\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,\n            detail=\"Payment cannot be voided in its current status\",\n        )\n\n    # Update the payment\n    db_payment.status = \"voided\"\n    db_payment.voided_at = datetime.utcnow()\n    db_payment.void_reason = payload.void_reason\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(db_payment)\n\n    return db_payment"
